I have some schooling and I can do sums, but this plot is only 0.27 hectares and it is rented, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer. One bag is too much for this small land and I need that money for my children's school fees. I will put manure from my cattle because it costs me nothing, and I will plant local cassava cuttings I kept from last season. My wife and I will weed it by hand, and I will not hire anyone. I expect we will spend about 24 days on this plot from planting to harvest.
